Issues found: Diff is a full duplicate of already-merged commit 9e1510b: the target file already exists on main with byte-for-byte identical content, so this PR adds zero new information and should not be merged as-is (either a stale/rebase-needed branch or a re-submission of already-landed work).; Applying this 'new file' diff against current main is not clean since the file already exists at that path -- confirms this PR was generated against a stale base and was never rebased before being queued for review.; No .github/workflows/** paths touched -- hard rule from SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md not implicated.
